Dec 2025 • Couples
Roza is the perfect place to unwind in the evening. The rooftop bar is spacious, with gentle music and warm lighting that sets a cozy mood. I tried two cocktails — both were excellent and beautifully balanced. The food was well-seasoned and pleasantly light, never too salty. The pool added an elegant and peaceful touch to the experience, making the whole evening feel calm and refreshing. It’s a wonderful spot to relax, sip a drink, and enjoy the atmosphere.
